meta.name: paid-ads-linkedin
meta.description: Plan and review LinkedIn Ads with B2B targeting, lead-quality, and budget guardrails. Use for LinkedIn advertising, sponsored content, lead-generation forms, job-title or company targeting, or LinkedIn campaign performance.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 规划并复盘 LinkedIn 广告投放,把控预算与线索质量
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果负责 B2B 广告投放,需要控制预算并优化线索质量
copy.tagline_en: Plan and review LinkedIn ads, with guardrails on budget and lead quality
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you run B2B LinkedIn ads and need to control spend and lead quality

howto.what: 此技能让 Claude 依据 B2B 目标、受众或领英导出,产出可执行的广告计划,包含目标、受众逻辑、预算、创意与质量指标;并支持按完整周期复盘广告数据,区分线索数量与质量。
howto.when: 当你提出领英广告相关需求,如制作赞助内容、设置线索表单,或按职位、公司等定向,或要求分析广告效果时触发。

say.text: 帮我规划一个面向金融行业财务总监的领英赞助内容广告
say.note: Claude 会生成包含受众逻辑与预算的广告计划

say.text: 分析这份领英广告周报,把有效线索从总线索里分出来
say.note: Claude 按完整周期拆分线索数量与质量

say.text: 给这组领英广告设置每日预算上限,并定义一个质量指标
say.note: Claude 在提案中加入预算与质量指标

howto.what_en: Enables Claude to produce an operator-ready LinkedIn Ads brief from a B2B goal, audience, or export, covering objective, audience logic, lead form vs landing page, budget, creative, and quality metric. Also reviews full-period campaign data, separating lead quantity from lead quality.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you ask for LinkedIn advertising, sponsored content, lead-gen forms, job-title or company targeting, or campaign performance analysis.

say_en.text: Plan a LinkedIn sponsored-content ad targeting finance VPs.
say_en.note: Claude produces a brief with audience logic and budget.

say_en.text: Analyze this weekly LinkedIn report; separate qualified leads from total.
say_en.note: Claude reviews the full period, keeping quantity distinct from quality.

say_en.text: Set a daily budget cap for these LinkedIn ads and define a quality metric.
say_en.note: Claude drafts the brief with budget and quality guardrails.
